## Summary

Describe the proposed change and why it is needed.

## Scope / affected files

What files, URLs, workflows, translations, dependencies and user-facing behavior change?

## Test results

List checks actually run, their results, and what has **not** been verified. Include browser/real deployment status as applicable.

## Rollback / recovery

Explain how to restore the previous state, any backups, and steps to reverse migration or deployment changes.

## Documentation checklist (mandatory)

- [ ] Added an entry to `docs/WEBSITE_UPDATES.md` (or the relevant repository change log).
- [ ] Updated affected README, guides, security, support, architecture or runbook documentation in **this same PR**.
- [ ] Included purpose, scope, verification results, limitations and recovery instructions.
- [ ] Confirmed no undocumented changes remain.
- [ ] Clearly identified any live deployment or browser QA not yet verified.
